sourceQualifications.description: 60MM/30control marrow donors supply cross-sectional expression data, not a trial giving ASA to90people. ASA treatment occurs inU266/RPMI-8226cultures; no own animal efficacy or clinical response/survival/tumor-shrinkage endpoint.

MM newly diagnosed before chemotherapy, control patients have ITP or iron-deficiency anemia, age42-73 refers controls. They are not established healthy matched volunteers. Donor disease/age/treatment confounding and exact analyzedN per gene not shown; no causal Blimp1 expression inference.

ASA0/.5/2.5/5mmol/L in cultured cells,CCK8at24/48/72h andflow72h. Millimolar culture concentrations not81mg/day or established achievable human marrow exposure; no PK/bioavailability/clinical therapeutic window established.

Text U266 IC50 7.631/6.356/3.179mM andRPMI8.583/6.024/2.833mM at24/48/72h. Early IC50s exceed maximum5mM tested; source fit/extrapolation uncertainty not quantified. RPMI is not more sensitive at every timepoint:24hIC50higherthanU266. No conversion to dose advice.

CCK8 metabolic/proliferation inhibition not clinical tumor killing or survival. Text RPMI72h inhibition29.56/48.60/68.35% at.5/2.5/5mM is inhibition, not remainingviability/apoptosis. Exact graph means/SD/CI not reconstructed from visual bars.

AnnexinV/7AAD plots support cellular apoptosis readouts, not human benefit/safety. Printed flow quadrants are representative panels, not independent patient Ns or group-mean precision. shRNA exact53.2/37.0U266 and46.4/61.7RPMI text are post-knockdown totals, not aspirin dose effects.

Unresolved source concern: Fig3B RPMI8226 ASA2.5mM andFig4B RPMI8226 shRNA#1 have identical printed quadrants4.3/26.4/49.3/20.0% and visually similar point patterns. Figure origin/rawFCS not checked; cause not adjudicated and no misconduct conclusion. Do not accept those panels as independently established mechanistic replication; requires raw/author/integrity adjudication under separate scope.

Two shBlimp1 constructs raise apoptosis/ATF4CHOP; overexpression lowers pathway expression. No ASA plus Blimp1 rescue or ATF4/CHOP loss-of-function necessity test reported. Perturbing Blimp1 and observing ASA associations doesnot establish entire necessary/sufficient aspirin mechanism.

Overall pathway association is not uniformly monotonic. Discussion explicitly saysATF4CHOPdecreasedat.5mMASA; Fig6B RPMIprotein/mRNA lower at.5. U266mRNAtrenddiffers. Negativefeedback/noncodingRNAexplanation speculative,notexperimentallyresolved.

Figures2-4 saythreeindependentexperiments/meanSD; exactbiological-versustechnicalreplicatehierarchy andNperallpanels not supplied. Manygenes/lines/doses/times; Bonferroni is reported but exactper-paneladjustment,randomization/blinding/power/missingness not described. Stars not exactP/CI.

Normal-derived donors only baselineexpression,not a parallel aspirin viability/safety comparator. No demonstrated selective tumor toxicity, normalmarrow safety, bleeding risk, in-vivo antitumor efficacy or clinically effective dose follows.

Source PRMD1/AFT4/RPIM/7-ADD andpreventivedrugforbronchitis wording not silently repaired into new claims. MethodLV-Blimp1 silencing wording versus overexpression retained through actual result-specific constructs. DiscussionJiangref44 actually listsDing2014,ref31 mechanisticclaim pairedwithdiagnosticcriteria. Cited mechanisms not freshly validated originals.

Measured expression/proliferation/apoptosis andgeneticperturbations distinct from authorclaims of ATF4CHOP mediation,COX/Akt/mTOR/NFkB/Bcl2background and presumedhumananticanceruse. No direct promoter-binding/occupancy,necessaryCHOPrescue or patient biomarker-outcome relation establishedhere.
